mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forest_fire_information ( fire_id, fire_damage_area, fire_end_time, fire_cause, fire_loc_village, fire_start_time, fire_expose_yn ) VALUES ( #{fireId}, #{fireDamageArea}, #{fireEndTime}, #{fireCause}, #{fireLocVillage}, #{fireStartTime}, 'Y' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fire_damage_area = VALUES(fire_damage_area), fire_end_time = VALUES(fire_end_time), fire_cause = VALUES(fire_cause), fire_loc_village = VALUES(fire_loc_village), fire_start_time = VALUES(fire_start_time)

INSERT INTO earthquake_event ( seq, lat, lon, loc, rem, tm_fc, msc, mt, expose_yn ) VALUES ( #{seq}, #{lat}, #{lon}, #{loc}, #{rem}, #{tmFc}, #{msc}, #{mt}, 'Y' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE loc = VALUES(loc), mt = VALUES(mt), rem = VALUES(rem);

INSERT INTO typhoon_info ( typhoon_year, typhoon_no, typhoon_name, typhoon_name_desc, typhoon_active_yn, typhoon_first_location ) VALUES ( #{typhoonYear}, #{typhoonNo}, #{typhoonName}, #{typhoonNameDesc}, #{typhoonActiveYn}, #{typhoonFirstLocation} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE typhoon_active_yn = VALUES(typhoon_active_yn), typhoon_name_desc = VALUES(typhoon_name_desc);

INSERT INTO typhoon_track ( typhoon_year, typhoon_no, typhoon_analysis_datetime, typhoon_lat, typhoon_lon, typhoon_move_speed, typhoon_central_pressure, typhoon_max_wind_speed, typhoon_radius_15ms, typhoon_radius_25ms, typhoon_location, typhoon_report_no ) VALUES ( #{typhoonYear}, #{typhoonNo}, #{typhoonAnalysisDatetime}, #{typhoonLat}, #{typhoonLon}, #{typhoonMoveSpeed}, #{typhoonCentralPressure}, #{typhoonMaxWindSpeed}, #{typhoonRadius15ms}, #{typhoonRadius25ms}, #{typhoonLocation}, #{typhoonReportNo} )
INSERT INTO lnld_forecast_info ( lnld_frcst_nm, sgg_nm, predc_anls_dt, data_std_dt, use_yn, reg_dt ) VALUES ( #{lnldFrcstNm}, #{sggNm}, #{predcAnlsDt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO kma_weather_report ( tm_fc, tm_seq, area_code, warn_var, stn_id, area_name, warn_stress, start_time, end_time, type, reg_dt ) VALUES ( #{tmFc}, #{tmSeq}, #{areaCode}, #{warnVar}, #{stnId}, #{areaName}, #{warnStress}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{type}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE area_name = VALUES(area_name), warn_stress = VALUES(warn_stress), start_time = VALUES(start_time), end_time = VALUES(end_time), type = VALUES(type), warn_var = VALUES(warn_var)
mapper.select: SELECT tm_fc AS tmFc, tm_seq AS tmSeq, area_code AS areaCode, warn_var AS warnVar, stn_id AS stnId, area_name AS areaName, warn_stress AS warnStress, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, type FROM kma_weather_report WHERE type = #{type} ORDER BY tm_fc DESC, tm_seq DESC
